title: Sideshow Toy The Twilight Zone 12-inch Figures
creator: Sideshow Toy
description: Sideshow Toy's early 12-inch Twilight Zone line consisted of highly articulated, cloth-costumed figures based on monsters and characters from the original series. Retail listings document an 'Eye of the Beholder' two-pack (the Doctor and the Nurse, limited to 5,000), the Kanamit from 'To Serve Man', the Gremlin from 'Nightmare at 20,000 Feet' and the Invader from 'The Invaders'. Toymania credits Mat Falls as sculptor of the Invader.
tz_connection: Each figure recreates a creature or character from a specific original-series episode.
recommendation_reason: Documents an officially licensed Twilight Zone collectible for the merchandise timeline.
